scenarios.scenario_abstract: When shopping entirely online for recreational running shoes, [X] compares specialist retailers, broad marketplaces, and brand sites by running use, price tier, previous-season discounts, delivery, fit tools, and return protection, deciding when a safer purchase channel is worth more than the lowest listing.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 只在线上购买休闲跑鞋时，[X]会按跑步用途、价格层级、上一代折扣、配送、尺码工具和退换保障，比较专业运动鞋网站、综合电商与品牌官网，并判断更稳妥的购买渠道何时值得比最低报价多花钱。
examples: choosing a discounted previous-season model from a reliable seller
paying more for free returns when fit cannot be tested first
rejecting a cheap marketplace listing when condition or authenticity is unclear

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While committing to a sixteen-week plan for a first 10K but declining a store visit, [X] measures both feet and assesses arch needs at home before comparing beginner running-shoe tiers, cushioning, expected durability, last-season savings, and whether an online return policy makes a poor fit reversible.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 准备执行十六周的首个 10 公里训练计划、但不愿去门店时，[X]会先在家测量双脚并判断足弓需求，再比较不同价位入门跑鞋的缓震、预期寿命、旧款折扣，以及线上退换政策能否降低不合脚的损失。
examples: buying an adequate entry pair after careful home measurement
using the mid-range tier for a better balance of support and mileage
choosing last season's model when the return terms remain equally strong

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While looking for comfortable casual women's shoes on a budget, [X] compares familiar everyday brands with under-USD-30 store labels, then checks whether the quoted ranges use the right currency and how local pricing, shipping, and import charges alter the apparent bargain.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在有限预算内寻找舒适的女式日常鞋时，[X]会把常见大众品牌与 30 美元以下的商店自有品牌比较，并进一步确认报价币种，以及当地定价、运费和进口费用会怎样改变表面上的便宜程度。
examples: choosing a store label when basic comfort is enough
moving to a familiar mid-price brand for support and durability
rejecting a low US price once delivery and import costs are included

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To sell an unneeded pair of shoes quickly, [X] cleans and documents its exact condition, compares similar listings, and trades off a lower local asking price against platform fees, shipping delay, authentication, payment protection, and scam exposure.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 想尽快卖掉一双不再需要的鞋时，[X]会先清洁并如实记录具体成色、参考相似成交价，再权衡本地低价快售与平台手续费、发货等待、鉴定、付款保障和诈骗风险。
examples: pricing below comparable local listings for a fast cash sale
accepting platform fees for payment or authenticity protection
holding the price when clear condition evidence supports it

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building a consistent running habit, [X] asks how much proper running shoes actually help and compares very cheap casual footwear with a quality beginner tier, judging the spend by comfort, support, injury interruption, and approximate training mileage rather than expecting the pair to create speed.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 正在建立稳定跑步习惯时，[X]想知道合适跑鞋究竟能带来多大帮助，于是会比较廉价休闲鞋与质量合格的入门跑鞋，并按舒适、支撑、受伤导致的训练中断风险和大致可用里程判断花费，而不是期待鞋本身带来速度。
examples: staying near the quality sweet spot instead of buying a premium racer
paying enough to avoid an unsuitable casual shoe during regular training
replacing by lost cushioning and mileage rather than fashion cycles

scenarios.scenario_abstract: When a familiar pair is tight enough to hurt their toes, [X] compares a no-cost overnight freezer stretch, heat or stuffing methods, an adjustable stretcher and spray, a modest cobbler fee, and eventual replacement against material stretch limits and the risk of damaging the pair.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一双常穿的鞋已经挤痛脚趾时，[X]会比较免费的冷冻过夜撑鞋法、加热或填塞、购买撑鞋器与喷剂、支付一笔不高的修鞋费，以及最终换鞋，同时考虑材质可拉伸程度和把鞋弄坏的风险。
examples: trying the free reversible method before spending on tools
paying a cobbler when the pair is worth preserving
replacing rather than repeatedly funding fixes for the wrong shape

scenarios.scenario_abstract: With USD 75 for a mother's birthday and knowing that she enjoys both cooking and shopping for shoes, [X] compares supportive slippers, a shoe-store gift card paired with a small kitchen item, and a size-free gift, treating fit uncertainty, personal choice, and use of the fixed total as part of footwear value.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 有 75 美元为母亲准备生日礼物、且知道她既喜欢做饭也喜欢逛鞋店时，[X]会比较有支撑的拖鞋、鞋店礼品卡搭配小型厨具，以及无需尺码的礼物，把尺码不确定、让收礼人自行选择和固定预算的利用程度都纳入鞋类价值判断。
examples: using most of the budget on supportive slippers when size is known
choosing a smaller shoe-store credit when personal selection matters more
avoiding a footwear purchase when sizing risk overwhelms its gift value

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While shopping for breathable, comfortable footwear for summer walking on Italian cobblestones, [X] compares budget high-street options with durable canvas or leather and more sustainable European brands, checking delivery speed, EU-versus-UK customs exposure, and whether one versatile pair can cover the trip.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为意大利夏季石板路步行选购透气舒适的鞋时，[X]会比较平价高街选项、耐用帆布或皮革鞋和更可持续的欧洲品牌，同时核对送达速度、欧盟与英国渠道的关税风险，以及一双多用途鞋能否覆盖整趟旅行。
examples: buying one affordable breathable pair from an Irish or EU seller
paying more for leather or canvas when it improves heat comfort and longevity
rejecting a nominally cheaper UK option after customs and delivery risk

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a low-budget winter Camino lasting more than a month, [X] treats walking shoes or trail runners and good socks as the highest-priority gear spend because of snow, ice, long daily distances, and limited services, excluding unnecessary equipment while protecting fit, grip, weather readiness, and an emergency buffer.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 计划用低预算完成一个多月的冬季全程圣地亚哥之路时，[X]面对雪、冰、长距离日行和淡季服务减少，会把步行鞋或越野跑鞋与好袜子作为最优先的装备支出，同时避免过度购置，并保住合脚、防滑、应对天气和旅行应急金。
examples: spending first on proven fit and grip while borrowing nonessential gear
choosing a durable mid-price trail runner within the full trip budget
rejecting a premium feature that would consume the weather buffer

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After progressing from basic jazz steps to a small stage performance, [X] buys professional jazz shoes and immediately feels freer movement, then judges the specialist purchase by repeated class use, technical benefit, durability, and when another dedicated pair would outperform ordinary training footwear.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 从爵士舞基础步伐进步到参加小型演出后，[X]会购买一双专业爵士舞鞋并立即感到动作更自由；之后再根据后续课程使用频率、技术收益、耐用性，以及何时专用鞋确实比普通训练鞋更值得，来判断这笔专业装备支出。
examples: accepting the specialist price when movement improves across regular classes
using the current pair longer while its technical benefit remains intact
returning to ordinary training footwear when specialized use is too infrequent
